Enterprise & Business Connectivity Commercial Policy

Document ID: Policy_C23_enterprise_terms

Category: C23 — Enterprise & Business Services

Department: Enterprise Sales

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

1. Purpose

Sets the general commercial and service framework for enterprise and business customers, superseded in specifics by individually signed agreements.

2. Policy Statements

Enterprise pricing is volume-tiered and subject to a minimum committed line count.

Each enterprise account is assigned a dedicated Account Manager and centralised billing.

Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for connectivity uptime and fault-resolution time are defined per contract, typically stricter than standard consumer SLAs.
title: Enterprise & Business Connectivity Commercial Policy
